author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: परं निधानं मुक्याश्रयः । शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता अनादिपरम्पराप्राप्त-धर्मरक्षकः । अव्ययो ह्रासहीनः सनातनोऽनादिनित्यः पुरुषो मे मतः ॥ ११.१८॥
translation: Thou art the supreme Akshara, the supreme object of knowledge. Thou art of this universe the highest support; Thou art changeless, the guardian of the eternal Dharma (virtue); Thou art the eternal Purusha; Thou art concluded (as such) by me. (18)
